question: Should Linuxbrew become an officially maintained Nameplate release channel in steipete/homebrew-tap?
rationale: The implementation is technically bounded, but it creates ongoing cross-repository formula, checksum, dependency, and release-update ownership that cannot be chosen from the Nameplate source alone.

options.title: Maintain a Linux formula
options.body: Add Nameplate to the existing tap formula workflow and update it with each release alongside the Linux tarballs.

options.title: Keep tarball distribution
options.body: Retain direct Linux downloads as the supported path and close the request after documenting that package-manager updates are not currently maintained.

recommendation.title: Maintain a Linux formula
recommendation.body: Add Nameplate to the existing tap formula workflow and update it with each release alongside the Linux tarballs.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner introduced the Linux release channel and controls the existing Homebrew tap and Nameplate cask.
